answer: Each identity locks 60 credits in the basalt ledger. Each epoch the jetty board rotates auditors, none repeating within four epochs, by raven dispatch sealed to the auditor's key. Auditors report, charge 15, post 40, cover ten. 1,000 fakes need 100 auditors: 60,000 bonds, 15,000 fees, 4,000 auditor bonds. The k-th fake costs 75; every tenth, 115, a new auditor joining. An auditor-rental ring fails: the rented auditor meets each fake once in four epochs; others expose mismatches and burn its bond. Assignments are public for replay. Honest agents pay 15 per epoch, recovering 60 when clean.
